arms.fixed_rule: equal total risk for present and ancient cohorts, not a VAL grid search
arms.normalization: LP and LA each normalized by exact original represented query-bp in the same parent

diagnostic_alternatives.both_continuations_gain_similarly: Continued adaptation/budget is a plausible explanation
diagnostic_alternatives.neither_gains: Still unresolved among optimization, representation capacity, inferred-tree error and reference information
diagnostic_alternatives.treatment_gains_with_same_information: Old accuracy was not an absolute input-information ceiling

matched_conditions: identical complete952-panel observations and original tree/SNP/physical support
same all-trainable H042 body and identical initial state
same optimizer settings and per-parent gradient clipping
no early stopping or VAL-dependent schedule/weight tuning
prerequisite: Root evaluates frozen H046 first and independently decides whether to register this condition.

proposed_practical_falsifier.failure_interpretation: Reject this fixed objective allocation at this budget; not a Bayes-limit proof.

recommendation: Test finite optimization/objective allocation before another exchange residual; do not infer Bayes saturation from small operator gains.
title: Cohort-normalized endpoint risk versus matched all-query continuation
